quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, the driver of the vehicle on the left shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: two vehicles enter one intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, with the subject vehicle on the left, subject to the stated control and opposite-direction left-turn exclusions

obligation.description: the driver of the vehicle on the left yields the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right

exceptions.trigger: intersection controlled by official traffic-control devices except as otherwise provided in subsection 4
exceptions.effect: the subsection-2 rule does not apply unless subsection 4 governs
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices

exceptions.trigger: vehicles approach from opposite directions and one driver intends or makes a left turn
exceptions.effect: the subsection-2 rule does not apply
exceptions.replacement_obligation: applicable left-turn duty requires separate review
exceptions.source_clause: or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

timing.description: compare original complete vehicle-body entry times; observe priority and yielding through the encounter

judgment_calls_needed.note: The supplied law has no numeric legal simultaneity cutoff.
Original motion and priority context are required; no speed or time surrogate decides the duty.
Official status and governance require independent source review; Native light state alone is insufficient.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: intending to or is making a left turn
judgment_calls_needed.note: Turn intention and realized trajectory require route and original heading/body evidence.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s, without legal cutoff
